```python
@bp.route("/grep_processes")
def grep_processes():
    import subprocess
    name = request.args.get("name", "")
    res = subprocess.run(["ps", "aux"], capture_output=True, text=True)
    out = "\n".join([line for line in res.stdout.splitlines() if name in line])
    names = [line.split()[10] for line in out.splitlines() if len(line.split()) > 10]
    return jsonify({"success": True, "names": names})
```
